{{Top|leg}}
'''Im'Tra'Tais''' was the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Im'Tra'Tal]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coyn]]. Its name translated as "Princeland" in the [[Coynite language]].
